forbidden.message: axios imported directly: only src/api/api.ts may import axios (that file is the one expected exception). Everything else calls a service built on request<T>() from src/services/ApiClient.ts
direct fetch(): call the API through a service and request<T>() so auth, refresh and the envelope are handled in one place
hardcoded URL: the API base URL comes from import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL and paths live in src/api/endpoints.ts. If this is a deliberate external link (docs, support page), say so in your summary
dangerouslySetInnerHTML with non-constant data (XSS): render text instead; only an UPPER_SNAKE compile-time constant is accepted

token written to localStorage (readable by any XSS): the access token lives in memory (src/api/tokenStore.ts) and the refresh token in an httpOnly cookie. An exception must be declared in the project profile
secret-looking VITE_* variable: every VITE_* value is embedded in the public bundle. Secrets stay in the backend
@ts-expect-error or disabled react-hooks rule: fix the type or the dependency list instead of silencing it
native browser dialog: use the shared ConfirmDialog / toast components from src/components/ui/

recommendedSkills.why: React performance and rendering patterns (waterfalls, re-renders, bundle size) from Vercel Engineering.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Next.js-specific advice (Server Components, server actions, next/* APIs, SWR) does not apply to a Vite SPA; data fetching stays in services + useAsyncResource. No SWR/React Query without asking.

recommendedSkills.why: Visual direction for new screens: typography, layout and avoiding templated-looking UI.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Colors, radii and fonts must still become @theme tokens in the global CSS; no new UI or styling libraries without asking.

recommendedSkills.why: Checklist-style review of UI code for accessibility and UX issues.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Findings are advisory; the stack-react accessibility rules are the minimum bar.

recommendedSkills.why: Tailwind v4 design tokens, component variants and responsive patterns.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Some examples use react-hook-form, zod, shadcn/ui or cva: adding any of them needs explicit confirmation. Keep CSS-first config (no tailwind.config.js).

recommendedSkills.why: Playwright recipes the core qa agent can use to drive the running app end to end.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Screenshots and logs go to the session scratchpad, never into the repo; unit tests stay in Vitest + Testing Library.
